information_boundary: original input source snapshot, not historical T
business_boundary: Shanghai business date through historical T; not intraday availability; September18 execution only
nontrading_observations: retain as calendar CLOSED; never infer open/close timestamps or include in required open-session denominator
unknown_calendar_or_clocks: unavailable; not assumed closed or tradable
read_partitioning: all frozen business months in order, then native security/time order; one shared scope TMP per month; global snapshot key/version/lineage verification before partition reads
interval_end: daily half-open observation may end at next midnight; bound its full interval and cap observation_start before the following business date; never use this interval bound as knowledge_cutoff or mutate source clocks
